funding.raw: [$250] Focus mode: single-expense report with a new comment stays hidden after Clear cache and restart

admission.agent_reason: MelvinBot (CONTRIBUTOR) commits $250 USD in the issue title for [$250] Focus mode: single-expense report with a new comment stays hidden after Clear cache and restart; the repository's own product code at src/libs/ReportActionsUtils.ts implements the affected surface, so the work is a bounded code change here.
admission.scope_quote: Comments on a single-expense report land on its transaction thread. The [single-expense resolver](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/406fd2ec23618e2e8e7e8757949414219dcb0a30/src/libs/ReportActionsUtils.ts#L2596-L2667) requires the parent expense report's IOU action to identify that thread. Missing parent actions after a cache clear prevent the thread's comments from contributing to the parent's unread state and derived association.

commercial_review.reason: Live read of the issue, its comments, linked pull requests, README/CONTRIBUTING and licence: the payment commitment is written by the issue author (repository authority) in the issue itself, no withdrawal, no unpaid-work allegation and no conflicting terms.
